_comment: Hand-maintained: who runs a shop's checkout. 'hosted' = a cart service runs the shop and its checkout; 'self' = shop software the site installs and runs itself. 'name' is the webappanalyzer technology name. 'traces' are SafePeek's own traces on top of the fingerprint: 'hosts' (a domain and its subdomains the page loaded from), 'globals' (property paths), 'cookies' (names; a trailing * is a prefix); each was observed on live storefronts. A product needs two different families of trace by default. Scripts, DOM, HTML, URLs and hosts are one family, because an embedded widget or image leaves them together; JS globals, cookies, headers and meta tags are each their own. One generic trace appears on pages that are not the shop (BASE's own site links to shops; any page can embed a BigCommerce image). 'singleTraces' lists the evidence labels that are enough on their own: runtime traces only the running shop sets (JS global, cookie, response header, meta tag), never ones the fingerprint marks lower confidence; 'singleTraceReason' says why. Add a product only when its kind is clear, with its source.

platforms.name: stores.jp
platforms.singleTraceReason: its only trace is the STORES_JP global, set by the storefront

platforms.name: MakeShop
platforms.singleTraceReason: the MakeShop_* globals are set only by MakeShop storefront pages

platforms.name: ColorMeShop
platforms.singleTraceReason: its only trace is the Colorme global, set by the storefront

platforms.name: EcForce
platforms.singleTraceReason: the ec_force_* cookies are set by the ecforce storefront itself (_ec_force_session is often HttpOnly, ec_force_revision is readable)

platforms.name: Estore Shopserve
platforms.singleTraceReason: the ESTORE-KAGO-<shop> cart cookie is set by the Shopserve cart

platforms.name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
platforms.singleTraceReason: Demandware headers, cookies and static paths come from the storefront itself

platforms.name: Magento
platforms.singleTraceReason: Magento cookies, Mage globals and static paths come from the running install

platforms.name: WooCommerce
platforms.singleTraceReason: requires WordPress and matches WooCommerce's own runtime assets and cookies

platforms.name: PrestaShop
platforms.singleTraceReason: PrestaShop headers, cookies and module paths come from the running install

platforms.name: OpenCart
platforms.singleTraceReason: the OCSESSID cookie and OpenCart theme paths come from the running install

platforms.name: Welcart
platforms.singleTraceReason: requires WordPress and matches Welcart's own usces assets and cookies

platforms.name: Zen Cart
platforms.singleTraceReason: its only trace is Zen Cart's generator meta tag

platforms.name: osCommerce
platforms.singleTraceReason: the osCsid session cookie is set only by a running osCommerce install
